evidence.quote: Gross margin decreased 100 basis points to 50.2% of net sales. The decrease in gross margin was due to: • 120 basis points of decline from unfavorable product mix, • 70 basis points of product and packaging investments, • 60 basis points of higher restructuring costs, • 30 basis points of net tariff impact from higher costs and recognized recoveries, • 20 basis points of higher commodity costs, • 10 basis points of unfavorable foreign exchange impacts and • 10 basis points of other items and rounding.
